verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ שְׁמַע־ אֱלֹהִ֣ים קוֹלִ֣י בְשִׂיחִ֑י מִפַּ֥חַד א֝וֹיֵ֗ב תִּצֹּ֥ר חַיָּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ šə·ma‘- ’ĕ·lō·hîm qō·w·lî ḇə·śî·ḥî mip·pa·ḥaḏ ’ō·w·yêḇ tiṣ·ṣōr ḥay·yāy
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David Hear O God my voice of complaint preserve my life from dread of the enemy
verses.literalPt: OUVE, ó Deus, a minha voz na minha oração; guarda a minha vida do temor do inimigo.

verses.original: תַּ֭סְתִּירֵנִי מִסּ֣וֹד מְרֵעִ֑ים מֵ֝רִגְשַׁ֗ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.literal: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked from the mob of workers of iniquity
verses.literalPt: Esconde-me do secreto conselho dos maus, e do tumulto dos que praticam a iniqüidade.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁנְנ֣וּ כַחֶ֣רֶב לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם דָּרְכ֥וּ חִ֝צָּ֗ם דָּבָ֥ר מָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer šā·nə·nū ḵa·ḥe·reḇ lə·šō·w·nām dā·rə·ḵū ḥiṣ·ṣām dā·ḇār mār
verses.literal: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows
verses.literalPt: Que afiaram as suas línguas como espadas; e armaram por suas flechas palavras amargas,

verses.original: לִיר֣וֹת בַּמִּסְתָּרִ֣ים תָּ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם יֹ֝רֻ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א יִירָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lî·rō·wṯ bam·mis·tā·rîm tām piṯ·’ōm yō·ru·hū wə·lō yî·rā·’ū
verses.literal: ambushing the innocent in seclusion shooting suddenly without fear
verses.literalPt: A fim de atirarem em lugar oculto ao que é íntegro; disparam sobre ele repentinamente, e não temem.

verses.original: יְחַזְּקוּ־ לָ֨מוֹ׀ דָּ֘בָ֤ר רָ֗ע יְֽ֭סַפְּרוּ לִטְמ֣וֹן מוֹקְשִׁ֑ים אָ֝מְר֗וּ מִ֣י יִרְאֶה־ לָּֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḥaz·zə·qū- lā·mōw dā·ḇār rā‘ yə·sap·pə·rū liṭ·mō·wn mō·wq·šîm ’ā·mə·rū mî yir·’eh- lā·mōw
verses.literal: They hold fast to their evil purpose they speak of hiding their snares Who will see them they say
verses.literalPt: Firmam-se em mau intento; falam de armar laços secretamente, e dizem: Quem os verá?

verses.original: יַֽחְפְּֽשׂוּ־ עוֹלֹ֗ת תַּ֭מְנוּ חֵ֣פֶשׂ מְחֻפָּ֑שׂ וְקֶ֥רֶב אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֵ֣ב עָמֹֽק׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·pə·śū- ‘ō·w·lōṯ tam·nū ḥê·p̄eś mə·ḥup·pāś wə·qe·reḇ ’îš wə·lêḇ ‘ā·mōq
verses.literal: They devise injustice and say We have perfected a secret plan For the inner man and the heart are mysterious
verses.literalPt: Andam inquirindo malícias, inquirem tudo o que se pode inquirir; e ambos, o íntimo pensamento de cada um deles, e o coração, são profundos.

verses.original: וַיֹּרֵ֗ם אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים חֵ֥ץ פִּתְא֑וֹם הָ֝י֗וּ מַכּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.literal: But God will shoot them with arrows suddenly they will be wounded
verses.literalPt: Mas Deus atirará sobre eles uma seta, e de repente ficarão feridos.

verses.original: וַיַּכְשִׁיל֣וּהוּ עָלֵ֣ימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם יִ֝תְנֹדֲד֗וּ כָּל־ רֹ֥אֵה בָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ·šî·lū·hū ‘ā·lê·mōw lə·šō·w·nām yiṯ·nō·ḏă·ḏū kāl- rō·’êh ḇām
verses.literal: They will be made to stumble their own tongues turned against them All who see will shake their heads
verses.literalPt: Assim eles farão com que as suas línguas tropecem contra si mesmos; todos aqueles que os virem, fugirão.

verses.original: וַיִּֽירְא֗וּ כָּל־ אָ֫דָ֥ם וַ֭יַּגִּידוּ פֹּ֥עַל אֱלֹהִ֗ים וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥הוּ הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·rə·’ū kāl- ’ā·ḏām way·yag·gî·ḏū pō·‘al ’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ma·‘ă·śê·hū hiś·kî·lū
verses.literal: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God so they will ponder what He has done
verses.literalPt: E todos os homens temerão, e anunciarão a obra de Deus; e considerarão prudentemente os feitos dele.

verses.original: יִשְׂמַ֬ח צַדִּ֣יק בַּ֭יהוָה וְחָ֣סָה ב֑וֹ וְ֝יִתְהַֽלְל֗וּ כָּל־ יִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·maḥ ṣad·dîq Yah·weh wə·ḥā·sāh ḇōw wə·yiṯ·hal·lū kāl- yiš·rê- lêḇ
verses.literal: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him let all the upright in heart exult
verses.literalPt: O justo se alegrará no SENHOR, e confiará nele, e todos os retos de coração se gloriarão.
